description: Draft, schedule and publish social posts from Codex with PostDaily — Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Mastodon.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to PostDaily to draft, check, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Mastodon. Sign in with your PostDaily account and choose which workspaces Codex may use. Upload images and videos from your machine, turn a release into per-network drafts, and read your queue and analytics. Codex asks you before anything publishes, is deleted or is canceled.
